 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 07, 2026, 07:00:00 AM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Customers should mark November 7, 2026, on their calendars as banks will be fully operational on this first Saturday of the month. They will be able to process cash deposits, withdrawals, and cheque services. However, bank closures will occur on the second and fourth Saturdays. Additionally, with upcoming holidays such as Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti, it’s advisable to check the holiday schedule for effective banking planning. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online ​Are banks open or closed today? Check status​ Bank customers need to visit bank branches for certain transactions such as cash deposits, withdrawals, cheque-related services, locker access and other routine transactions. So, customers who push their bank-related work to Saturday should make sure to check if banks are open or closed today (November 7, 2026).
 Are banks open or closed today on Saturday, November 7, 2026?
Banks are open across India as it is the first Saturday of the month. Banks are closed only on the second and fourth Saturdays apart from Sundays and regional festivals.
Banks follow a working day on the first, third and fifth Saturdays in some cases unless specified as holidays in the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) holiday list.

Diwali/Laxmi Puj/Govardhan Pooja/Vishwakarma Day, Diwali (Bali Pratipada)/Deepawali (Govardhan Puja)/Laxmi Puja/Vikram Samvant New Year Day, Laxmi Puja (Deepawali)/Ningol Chakkouba/Bhratridwitiya/Bhaidooj/Chitragupt Jayanti, Wangala Festival, Chhath Puja/Surya Shashti Dala Chhath (Prath Arghya), Igas-Bagwal, Seng Kut Snem, Guru Nanak Jayanti/Karthika Purnima/ Rahas Purnima and Kanakadasa Jayanthi.
